title: Password reset regex rejects valid special characters and requires whitespace
steps: Open /forgot-password, enter a registered email, click "Lấy mã OTP"
Enter the OTP shown on screen and the new password `Reset@2026`
expected: Password accepted (≥ 8 chars, upper, lower, digit, one of @$!%*?&); alert "Đổi mật khẩu thành công!" and redirect to /login.
actual: Alert "Mật khẩu quá yếu!…" for every allowed special character (TC23: 0/7 accepted) and for lengths 8–65. `Reset 2026` (space as the special char) is accepted (TC14).

title: OTP generator issues 4-digit tokens instead of 6 digits
actual: All 20 samples have 4 digits (e.g. 2668, 3581); UI label also says "Mã OTP (4 số)".

title: Backend /api/reset-password does not validate the password policy
actual: HTTP 200; login with "123" succeeds. The only policy check is in the (buggy) client.
cause: Route updates the password without any validation.

title: Step 2 has no "Confirm New Password" field
expected: Two password inputs (new + confirm) and a mismatch error.
actual: Only one password input exists (`input[type=password]` count = 1).

title: No step indicator and no "Back to Login" control
expected: "Step 1 / 2" / "Step 2 / 2" indicator and a link back to /login.
actual: No indicator; only "← Quay lại" (back to step 1) exists.

title: Backend trusts client-supplied total_amount (0, negative, tampered)
steps: Log in, add iPhone 15 Pro Max ×1, open checkout
Change "Tổng tiền thanh toán" to 1 and confirm (or POST /api/checkout with total_amount 0 / -500000 / quantity 0)
actual: Order stored with total_amount = 1 / 0 / -500000; quantity 0 accepted (HTTP 200).
cause: Route inserts `total_amount` from the request body; items are ignored.

title: Grand total is an editable number input on the checkout page
Guest can open /checkout without logging in
steps: As a guest (header shows "Đăng nhập"), open http://localhost:5173/checkout
cause: No route guard; only the cart button checks `user`.

title: Cart is not cleared after a successful checkout
steps: Log in, add a product, checkout until "Thanh toán thành công!"
actual: The purchased items are still in the cart.

title: CSV import is not atomic – valid rows are kept when another row fails
steps: Admin → Sản phẩm → upload data/fr16/mixed-atomic.csv (2 valid rows + 1 row without name)
cause: Rows are inserted one by one without a transaction.

title: CSV parser splits quoted fields on commas (RFC 4180)
steps: Upload data/fr16/quoted-comma.csv containing `"HW04 Gaming Laptop, 16GB RAM",25000000,…`
actual: Product name `"HW04 Gaming Laptop` and the remaining columns shifted.

title: CSV import accepts zero and negative prices
expected: Row rejected (price must be > 0); 0 products added.
actual: "Import hoàn tất: 1/1 sản phẩm được thêm"; product saved with price -10000 / 0.

title: File input has no accept=".csv" restriction
steps: Admin → Sản phẩm → inspect the import file input
actual: No `accept` attribute; a .txt file is previewed and importable.

title: Import API accepts any logged-in user token (no admin role check) – NEW in HW04
steps: Register a normal user and log in (role = user)
POST /api/admin/import-products with `Authorization: Bearer <user token>` and the rows of data/fr16/valid.csv
cause: Route uses `authenticateToken` only and never checks `req.user.role === 'admin'`.
